heldout_execution: Exactly one evaluation after development fixes and explicit freeze; no tuning on held-out results.

known_failure.context: Dark monospace terminal notification, 23px token text, 2 second exposure
known_failure.meaning: The original OCR miss repeats on output. Independent truth-based pixel verification catches exposure; same-model rescan is not a privacy guarantee.

method.event_match: One-to-one event type + >=50% overlap of expected text bbox on at least one expected frame
method.coverage: Every annotated text bbox at every annotated frame; >=99.5% pixels with max RGB channel<=16
method.heldout_by: Three entire background UI layouts held out; three different backgrounds used for development
method.positive_event_types: email, phone, dummy token, supplied custom keyword

limitations: Synthetic fictional English UI data, not customer recordings or market validation.
Sensitive notification-card rendering is shared across splits; only background layouts are held out. This is a narrow reproducible functionality test, not evidence of broad UI generalization.
High-contrast text is 23-28px. Low-resolution, compressed, oblique, unfamiliar text, other languages, faces, spoken secrets, and variable-frame-rate video are not validated by this set.
Exact-frame caching makes static lossless clips faster than changing/lossy recordings. Timings cannot be extrapolated to real-time processing.
Small correlated sample: report 24/24 held-out events, not a universal 100% accuracy claim.
Manual review remains necessary. One development token miss survived output rescan.
UGen300/Hailo acceleration has not been tested on actual hardware.
